adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `updateAllCalendarEvents` was changed to collect all calendar references via `.filter(...)` and then loop them (`for (const reference of calendarReference)`). Inside that loop, when a matching credential isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } ... })`. Because this `findUnique` is awaited inside the loop, multiple calendar references (e.g., scaling with host count in collective/team scenarios) will trigger sequential DB round-trips rather than batching (e.g., `findMany` over all needed IDs) or parallelizing. This is a diff-grounded performance/scalability concern, not a correctness defect.
